text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no way to execute commands in this session. I checked each fix by reading it against the tests, so please run the suite to confirm.

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`. It was leaving it as a string.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` now includes `Emma`, so the demo catalog has all three titles.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` now multiplies days by the daily rate. It was adding them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns the last `n` events. It was returning `n + 1`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests. It was 3.
- **`search.py`:** it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. It was importing from a module that doesn't exist.

I didn't change anything under `tests/`.
